title: lass fruticosa
intro: Lass fruticosa, commonly known as Lass's bush or Indian tobacco, is a plant species that belongs to the family Apocynaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, coughs, and colds, thanks to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, which provide relief from congestion and soothe irritated tissues. The health benefits of Lass fruticosa include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate symptoms of bronchitis, and treat various skin conditions, such as eczema and dermatitis. The bioactive constituents of Lass fruticosa include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
